$comment: Kit toolchain manifest - DATA only (versions, floors, policy); version probing and the doctor report live in cli/src/engine-native/toolchain.ts, and the one managed install lives in cli/src/engine-native/bun.ts bunBootstrap. kind: check (doctor visibility only) | managed (kit installs it when missing) | pin (no binary probe - a version pin for a package the kit installs through another tool, such as npx or `omp install`; `via` names that tool in the doctor table, default npx). policy (managed only): present (install when missing, never upgrade). `verified` = last kit-tested version; `pinnable` marks a tool whose `verified` release the bootstrap can install by exact tag. Supply-chain stance: every kit-driven package install from npm, npx, GitHub releases, or `omp install` is pinned to `verified` - never floating @latest (npm-worm/Shai-Hulud surface). rust-analyzer (rustup) follows the host toolchain and has no pin; the existing Claude Code and omp marketplace plugins follow their marketplace and have no pin. Any new install surface, a new marketplace or plugin source included, needs a pin first. Update `verified` after testing a new release. upstream (optional) names where `docks-kit toolchain outdated` reads the newest release: npm package (optional major line) or GitHub repo releases with a tag prefix; results cache 24 h in ~/.docks-kit/kit.db; the report never installs or edits pins.

jq.note: optional operator CLI; EngineNative JSON and Claude runtime do not invoke it

curl.note: installer transport for the Bun bootstrap on every host (install.sh on POSIX, install.ps1 on Windows); probed only when Bun is missing

git.note: plugin marketplaces (claude clones them) + kit checkout updates

node.note: hosts the npm globals installed for the Claude LSP plugins; the floor is typescript-language-server 6's engines requirement, so an older Node reports `below-floor` in `docks-kit toolchain` instead of silently installing an LSP server that cannot start

npm.note: npm-global installer; also backs the intelephense version probe (`npm ls -g`)

claude.note: kit floor — lets the `opus` alias resolve to Opus 5.5, the default Opus from Claude Code 2.1.280, and subsumes the older Fable 5.1 (>=2.1.257) and Opus 5 (>=2.1.219) requirements (mirrors settings minimumVersion)

omp.note: Oh My Pi harness (https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi); upstream-owned. It updates through `omp update` or through the external manager that owns the install (for example Tern), and sync never installs or upgrades it. The floor is the oldest release the kit tested: 19.0.0 lists every model selector of the kit roles exactly, accepts every key of SoT/.omp/config.yml, and runs the bash approval order that cli/test/lib/ompBashPatterns.ts ports. `sync omp` needs the CLI only for the marketplace and plugin passes; the file deploys proceed without it

ffplay.note: Notification hook sound; distro-installed, so no kit floor applies

intelephense.note: php-lsp server; `verified` pins claudeLsp.ts syncLspServers' npm install. Version comes from `npm ls -g` — its own --version prints minified source

typescript-language-server.note: typescript-lsp server binary; `verified` pins claudeLsp.ts syncLspServers' npm install. Version 6 requires Node >=22.22.2 (see the `node` floor)

rust-analyzer.note: rust-analyzer-lsp server binary; claudeLsp.ts syncLspServers installs it with `rustup component add rust-analyzer` when rustup is present, so the version follows the host Rust toolchain and no verified pin applies. A host without rustup is skipped in silence

tsc.note: typescript-lsp dependency (npm package `typescript`); `verified` pins claudeLsp.ts syncLspServers' npm install. Deliberately on the 6.x line: typescript-language-server embeds TypeScript's programmatic API, which TS7 (native) doesn't yet expose — the repo's own devDependency stays on TS7 for editors, and `bun check` runs the type check with the same errors

bun.note: runtime for the docks-kit CLI and the Claude statusline/hook programs; bootstrap installs the verified release (installer takes bun-vX.Y.Z); self-updates via `bun upgrade` when wanted. By owner decision (2026-09-25), the floor equals the verified pin and the CI Bun, and the checkout launchers refuse an older Bun. All three moved to 1.4.4 on 2026-10-22 for `bun check`

skills-cli.note: the `skills` npm package the kit runs via `npx skills@<verified>` when SoT/.agents/skills.txt names a slug (it is empty by default) — pinned, never @latest

pi-intercom.note: the cross-session messaging plugin ompSync installs with `omp install pi-intercom@<verified>` - pinned, never floating. Its broker runs under Bun because omp's flat plugin store cannot resolve the default `npx --no-install tsx` launcher
